# Command blocks

Blue recognizes **command blocks** in an instrument's Global Orchestra
text when building a CSD. They mainly support older self-contained
instruments whose global code must be ordered or emitted only once.
Ordinary project-wide code belongs in [Global Orchestra](globals.qmd).

A block starts with `;[command]{` and ends with `;}` on their own lines:

```csound-orc
;[once]{
gaShared init 0
;}
```

`once` emits identical block text only once from the collected instrument
global code. `pre` moves its block to the beginning of that collected code:

```csound-orc
;[pre]{
giEngine fluidEngine
;}
```

The implementation compares `once` blocks by their exact content and
recognizes only `once` and `pre`. A well-formed block with another command name
is discarded. Keep each opener and closer well formed: an unclosed block can
swallow the rest of the collected Global Orchestra text. Use **Project →
Generate CSD to Screen** to verify the placement and deduplication before
rendering an imported instrument. These blocks do not provide a general Csound
preprocessor.
